lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}一望无垠，恰如沉睡在拉莱耶外围的死水，吞没了所有归航的坐标。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} stretches without shore, like the dead waters ringing R'lyeh that swallow every chart.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}遮蔽了天日，却遮不住树根下悄然滋长的深渊阴影。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} shuts out the sun, yet cannot hide the Abyssal shadow creeping beneath its roots.

lines.zh: 晴空炙烤着{dimension}的{biome}，将一切生机晒成干裂的死寂。
lines.en: A cloudless sky scorches {biome} in {dimension}, baking all life into cracked desolation.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}高耸入云，然而即便站在山巅，你也依然仰望不到群星之外的真相。
lines.en: The peaks of {biome} in {dimension} pierce the clouds, yet even from their crests you cannot glimpse the truth beyond the stars.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}弥漫着腐朽的泥泞气息，仿佛珊瑚瘟疫随时会从死水底端渗出。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} reeks of stagnant mire, as though the Coralium Plague might seep from its pools at any hour.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}平坦的{biome}上，凡人毫无遮蔽地暴露在苍穹与深渊的双重注视之下。
lines.en: Upon the flat {biome} of {dimension}, mortals stand unsheltered beneath the twin gazes of sky and Abyss.

lines.zh: 严寒冻结了{dimension}的{biome}，连风雪的呼啸都带着几分来自黑暗国度的死寂。
lines.en: Bitter frost locks {biome} in {dimension}, and even its howling snow carries the dead hush of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}疯狂蔓生，缠绕的藤蔓掩盖了多少早已被遗忘的古老祭坛？
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} grows in blind frenzy; how many forgotten altars lie choked beneath its vines?

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}已被深渊气息浸透——这便是黑暗之地向现世伸出的第一道边界。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} is already steeped in Abyssal breath—the first border the Darklands carve into the waking world.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}奔流不息，将尘世的碎屑冲向未知的深海。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} rushes onward without pause, bearing earthly dross toward unknown depths.

lines.zh: 站在{dimension}的{biome}边缘，海潮正一遍遍抹去沙地上属于凡人的微末足迹。
lines.en: At the rim of {biome} in {dimension}, the tide scrubs away every fleeting mortal footprint.

lines.zh: 烈日照耀着{dimension}赤红的{biome}，暴露出大地如剥皮白骨般的古老岩层。
lines.en: Clear sun beats upon the crimson {biome} of {dimension}, laying bare ancient strata like flayed bone.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}笼罩在异界般的菌毯之中，连寻常的怪物都不愿轻易踏足。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} lies beneath an otherworldly fungal mat that even common beasts shun.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}翻涌着硫磺与烈焰，然则在真正的旧日支配者眼中，这不过是嘈杂的熔炉。
lines.en: Sulfur and flame churn across {biome} in {dimension}; yet to a Great Old One, this is merely a noisy furnace.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}漂浮在无光虚空之中，恰似被宇宙遗弃的破碎尸骸。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} drifts through lightless void like the shattered carcass of a forgotten world.

lines.zh: 你正立于{dimension}的{biome}——这片被珊瑚瘟疫彻底吞噬的苍白荒原，便是傲慢者的墓碑。
lines.en: You stand in the {biome} of {dimension}—this pale waste devoured by the Coralium Plague is the tombstone of the arrogant.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}浸透了恐惧瘟疫，连岩石与泥土都在查伽洛斯的阴影下扭曲畸变。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} is drenched in the Dread Plague; stone and soil alike warp beneath Chagaroth's shadow.

lines.zh: 欢迎来到{dimension}的{biome}，凡人。群星之外的圣城正以永恒的晦暗注视着你。
lines.en: Welcome to {biome} in {dimension}, mortal. The citadel beyond the stars watches you from eternal twilight.

lines.zh: 你已深入{dimension}的{biome}。在此无光之底，萨克索斯的怒火与暗影从未停歇。
lines.en: You have descended into {biome} of {dimension}. At this lightless floor, Sacthoth's wrath and shadows never rest.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}之中，连树木都在恐惧瘟疫的腐化下化作了扭曲的枯骨。
lines.en: Within the {biome} of {dimension}, even the trees have twisted into blighted bone under the Dread Plague.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}群峰耸立，红雾与瘴气在陡峭的岩壁间翻滚不休。
lines.en: Jagged peaks rise through {biome} in {dimension}, crimson mist and miasma rolling endlessly between their cliffs.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}散发着晦暗的木质腐气，每一棵扭曲的树干都仿佛在向奥穆索俯首。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} exhales a dim, woody rot; every twisted trunk seems to bow toward Omothol.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里，腐烂的泥沼与暗影石交织在一起，滋养着未知的畸变。
lines.en: In the {biome} of {dimension}, stagnant mire and Darkstone entwine, nursing nameless mutations.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}一片晦暗开阔，仿佛随时准备迎接仪式祭坛的降临。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} stretches dim and open, as if awaiting the raising of a ritual altar.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}峰峦漆黑如墨，山体深处沉睡着冰冷的渊素矿脉。
lines.en: The peaks of {biome} in {dimension} stand ink-black, guarding cold veins of Abyssalnite deep within.

lines.zh: {dimension}严寒的{biome}被冰雪封缄，枯枝在冻风中发出如同白骨摩擦的声响。
lines.en: Frigid {biome} in {dimension} lies sealed in frost, bare boughs rattling like dry bone in the wind.

lines.zh: 冰冷的浮冰漂浮在{dimension}的{biome}之上，水底的寒意足以瞬间冻结凡人的血脉。
lines.en: Drifting floes ride the {biome} of {dimension}; the chill beneath its waves can freeze mortal blood in a breath.

lines.zh: {dimension}那覆雪的{biome}直插苍穹，绝壁之上唯有刺骨的寒风与死寂。
lines.en: Snow-clad {biome} in {dimension} pierces the sky, its sheer crags home only to biting wind and silence.

lines.zh: 冰冷的夜雨正冲刷着{dimension}。黑暗与潮湿交织，最适合阴影在暗处潜行。
lines.en: Cold night rain scours {dimension}. Darkness and damp entwine—ideal cover for shadows prowling unseen.

lines.zh: 黑夜、暴雨与雷霆同时降临——仿佛天穹之上正有一位外神翻身苏醒。
lines.en: Night, storm, and thunder strike at once—as though some Outer God stirred in its sleep above the clouds.

lines.zh: 白昼晴朗无云，日光却照不透凡人对宇宙真相那根深蒂固的无知。
lines.en: Daylight shines clear and cloudless, yet cannot pierce mortal ignorance of cosmic truth.

lines.zh: 白昼被阴雨笼罩，灰暗的天色倒比刺眼的阳光更衬托这片荒诞的世界。
lines.en: Rain dims the daylight; this sullen gray suits an absurd world better than glaring sun.

lines.zh: 清朗的黎明微光洒在{dimension}，短暂地驱散了夜色，却驱不散潜伏在时间尽头的阴影。
lines.en: Clear dawn spills pale light across {dimension}, driving back the night for a moment yet never touching the shadow at time's end.

lines.zh: 黎明在阴雨中悄然到来，天色晦暗得仿佛黑夜从未真正离开。
lines.en: Dawn arrives wrapped in rain, so dim it seems the night never truly departed.

lines.zh: 晴朗的黄昏将天际染作残红，群星正准备在夜幕中重新睁开窥视的眼眸。
lines.en: A clear dusk stains the horizon bruised red, and the stars prepare to open their watching eyes.

lines.zh: 暮色与雨水一同垂落，世界在湿冷的晦暗里渐渐模糊了边界。
lines.en: Twilight and rain descend together, blurring the borders of the world in cold gloom.

lines.zh: 晴朗的夜空下，星辰密布——每一颗遥远的光点，都在冷漠地俯瞰着你的渺小。
lines.en: Beneath a clear night sky the stars crowd thick—each distant point looking coldly down upon your insignificance.

lines.zh: 白昼的雷暴撕裂天幕，在那一瞬间的电光里，连阳光都显得苍白无力。
lines.en: Daytime thunderbolts split the sky; in that stark flash, even the sun seems pale.

lines.zh: 黄昏的暴雨伴着雷鸣倾泻而下，宛如世界在迎接着黑夜的审判。
lines.en: Dusk's tempest pours down with roaring thunder, as though the world faced judgment at nightfall.

lines.zh: 即便在{dimension}这片没有天空的火狱里，焦热与烟尘也从未真正平息。
lines.en: Even in {dimension}, a furnace without a sky, scorching heat and ash never truly settle.

lines.zh: {dimension}的漆黑虚空永恒不变，没有风雨，唯有星辰之外的死寂。
lines.en: The pitch-black void of {dimension} never alters—no wind, no rain, only dead silence beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}之中，昼夜早已失去了意义，唯有永恒的暗红火光。
lines.en: Within {dimension}, day and night lost all meaning long ago; only eternal crimson glare remains.

lines.zh: 夜雨敲打着{dimension}的{biome}，枝叶的阴影在闪电与暗夜里化作张牙舞爪的轮廓。
lines.en: Night rain drums through {biome} in {dimension}, turning shadowed boughs into clawing silhouettes.

lines.zh: 黑夜与暴雨将{biome}化作一片沸腾的泥沼，鬼火与腐气在黑暗中悄然浮起。
lines.en: Night and rain turn {biome} into a seething mire where pale lights and rot drift unseen.

lines.zh: 白昼的烈阳炙烤着{dimension}干涸的{biome}，连一丝多余的云翳都不肯施舍。
lines.en: Noon sun beats down on parched {biome} in {dimension}, refusing even a scrap of cloud.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼铺展在{biome}之上，让你毫无遮蔽地暴露在天地之间。
lines.en: Clear daylight spreads across {biome}, leaving you bare between earth and sky.

lines.zh: 暴雨倾泻在{biome}的波涛之上，海天相接之处翻涌着深不可测的幽暗。
lines.en: Rain lashes the waves of {biome}, churning unfathomable gloom where sea meets sky.

lines.zh: 雷暴正猛烈冲击着{dimension}的{biome}，狂风与闪电在绝壁间咆哮不休。
lines.en: A thunderstorm batters {biome} in {dimension}, gale and lightning howling between the crags.

lines.zh: 雨水打湿了{dimension}的{biome}，暗影石在湿冷中泛出愈发幽深的光泽。
lines.en: Rain slicks {biome} in {dimension}, lending the Darkstone an even deeper, colder sheen.

lines.zh: 黄昏降临在{dimension}的{biome}，林间的长影正悄然苏醒。
lines.en: Dusk settles over {biome} in {dimension}, and long shadows stir between the trunks.

lines.zh: 黎明的第一缕微光掠过{dimension}的{biome}，海浪依旧不知疲倦地拍打着岸边。
lines.en: The first pale light of dawn brushes {biome} in {dimension}, while the surf beats endlessly on.

lines.zh: 黑夜笼罩着{dimension}闷热的{biome}，藤蔓阴影背后藏着无数双窥视的兽瞳。
lines.en: Night blankets steaming {biome} in {dimension}; behind tangled vines gleam countless watching eyes.

lines.zh: 极夜的寒风吹过{dimension}的{biome}，刺骨的冷意直透骨髓。
lines.en: Night winds sweep frigid {biome} in {dimension}, driving cold straight to the marrow.

lines.zh: 雨水汇入{dimension}的{biome}，浑浊的河水携带着泥沙奔向未知的深渊。
lines.en: Rain swells {biome} in {dimension}, carrying mud and silt toward unknown depths.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中，一具腐烂的{entity}正循着活人的气味蹒跚而来。
lines.en: Through the night, a rotting {entity} shambles toward the scent of living flesh.

lines.zh: 夜色掩护着那具{entity}，枯骨拉响弓弦的脆响在黑暗里格外刺耳。
lines.en: Darkness shields that {entity}; the creak of its bowstring cuts sharp through the night.

lines.zh: 在黑夜的掩护下，一只{entity}正悄无声息地向你的背后逼近。
lines.en: Under cover of night, a {entity} creeps silently toward your back.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，那只多足的{entity}已沿着阴影爬出巢穴。
lines.en: Night has fallen, and that many-legged {entity} has crawled out from its lair.

lines.zh: 雨水迫使{dimension}里的那只{entity}不断瞬移避雨——连虚空的游魂也畏惧凡尘的雨水。
lines.en: Rain drives that {entity} in {dimension} to blink frantically from place to place—even a void-walker flinches from earthly showers.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的迷雾深处，那个疯癫的{entity}正调配着散发恶臭的毒剂。
lines.en: Deep in the mists of {biome}, that crazed {entity} brews foul-smelling toxins.

lines.zh: {biome}的泥沼里正弹跳着一团黏腻的{entity}，与这片污浊之地倒也相配。
lines.en: A slick {entity} squelches through the mire of {biome}—a fitting tenant for such foul water.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}上，那个无知的{entity}仍在过着庸碌而脆弱的日常。
lines.en: Upon {biome} in {dimension}, that ignorant {entity} goes on with its dull, fragile days.

lines.zh: {biome}的林影之间，一头警觉的{entity}正用野性的目光审视着你。
lines.en: Among the trees of {biome}, a wary {entity} sizes you up with feral eyes.

lines.zh: 黑夜已深，另一位凡人{player}仍在暗处徘徊。记住，人心有时比深渊更难测。
lines.en: Night deepens while another mortal, {player}, still wanders nearby. Remember: human hearts can be murkier than the Abyss.

lines.zh: 一头饥渴的{entity}正在附近低吼，那副腐朽的躯壳对血肉有着无尽的贪欲。
lines.en: A starving {entity} snarls nearby, its decaying frame driven by endless hunger for flesh.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的苍白荒原里，一头不可名状的{entity}正沸腾蠕动——Tekeli-li!
lines.en: Across the pale wastes of {dimension}, a nameless {entity} churns and seethes—Tekeli-li!

lines.zh: {biome}的阴影里游荡着一头被珊瑚侵蚀的{entity}，宣告着腐化早已渗入此地。
lines.en: A Coralium-warped {entity} prowls the shade of {biome}, proof that corruption already walks here.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的血红迷雾中，一头狂暴的{entity}正带着恐惧瘟疫向你逼近。
lines.en: Through the crimson haze of {dimension}, a frenzied {entity} closes in with the Dread Plague.

lines.zh: {dimension}的虚空霸主{boss}正在天际盘旋——去折断它的傲慢吧，凡人！
lines.en: {boss}, sovereign of {dimension}, wheels across the void—go break its pride, mortal!

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的断壁残垣间，一名{entity}正用死灵之书的目光审视着你这具傀儡。
lines.en: Among the ruins of {dimension}, an {entity} appraises your simulacrum with the eyes of the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: 夜色最深处，一团来自黑暗国度的{entity}正悄然凝结成形。
lines.en: At the dead of night, a {entity} of the Dark Realm quietly gathers form.

lines.zh: {dimension}的焦土之上，一头暴虐的{entity}正挥舞着爪牙寻找猎物。
lines.en: Upon the scorched crust of {dimension}, a brutal {entity} hunts with bared claws.

lines.zh: 警告！一团扭曲法则的{entity}就在附近——稍有触碰便是湮灭的下场。
lines.en: Beware! An {entity} that mocks reality's laws drifts nearby—one touch means annihilation.

lines.zh: 死灵的威压笼罩四周，那尊强大的{boss}已将冰冷的视线投向了你。
lines.en: The weight of undeath presses down; that mighty {boss} has turned its cold gaze upon you.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}上，一尊沉默的{entity}正僵硬地守卫着尘世的领地。
lines.en: Across {biome} in {dimension}, a silent {entity} keeps stiff watch over earthly ground.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中足有{count}头怪物在四周躁动，为首的{hostile}已对你露出了獠牙。
lines.en: Full {count} foes stir through the night around you, led by {hostile} with bared fangs.

lines.zh: 四周仅有{player}一人与你相对。在这寂静里，秘密与刀锋往往只隔着一线。
lines.en: Only {player} stands opposite you here. In such quiet, secrets and steel sit a hair's breadth apart.

lines.zh: 夜幕下仅有{count}具诸如{entity}般的不死之物游荡，尚不足以构成威胁。
lines.en: Only {count} restless dead like {entity} wander the night—scarcely a host to fear.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里，那具{entity}身上似乎也沾染了几分晦暗的腐气。
lines.en: Within {biome} of {dimension}, even that {entity} seems stained with darkling rot.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的无光孤岛上，{entity}如幽灵般成群徘徊，守望着破碎的虚空。
lines.en: Upon the lightless isles of {dimension}, {entity} drift like ghosts guarding shattered void.

lines.zh: 夜雨中，那具{entity}的弓弦被雨水打湿，却依然执拗地瞄准着你的咽喉。
lines.en: In the night rain, that {entity}'s bowstring drips wet yet still aims stubbornly at your throat.

lines.zh: 暗夜里仅有一只{hostile}在附近徘徊。去吧，干净利落地解决它。
lines.en: Only a single {hostile} prowls the dark nearby. Go—end it cleanly.

lines.zh: 白昼的{biome}上，一只卑微的{animal}正安详地啃食草叶，对深渊一无所知。
lines.en: Upon sunlit {biome}, a humble {animal} grazes in peace, blind to the Abyss.

lines.zh: 忠诚的{entity}随侍左右，即便在{player}面前，它也只认得深渊的气息。
lines.en: Faithful {entity} attends you; even before {player}, it answers only to the scent of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 独行于无边的黑夜之中，唯有群星的冷光与我陪伴着这具傀儡。
lines.en: Alone in the boundless night, only the cold light of the stars and I keep this simulacrum company.

lines.zh: 深夜里四下无人，你却连一柄防身的兵器也未曾握在手中——真是狂妄，抑或愚蠢。
lines.en: Alone in the dead of night, yet you hold not a single weapon in hand—boldness, or sheer folly.

lines.zh: {dimension}的阴雨中别无他人，唯有雨滴敲打着你孤独的身影。
lines.en: None else walk the rain of {dimension}; only raindrops drum against your solitary form.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼下，你独自一人立于无垠的{biome}，宛如被世界流放的孤魂。
lines.en: Beneath clear noon light you stand alone in endless {biome}, like an exile cast out by the world.

lines.zh: 在这座空旷而破败的{dimension}圣城里，唯有你独行于万古的死寂之中。
lines.en: Within the ruined hush of {dimension}, you walk alone through ten thousand years of silence.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}无边无际的黑暗里，孤独会迅速啃噬凡人仅存的理智。
lines.en: In the boundless gloom of {dimension}, solitude swiftly gnaws away what little sanity a mortal keeps.

lines.zh: 独自徘徊在{dimension}的珊瑚荒原上，连食尸鬼的脚步声似乎都成了某种安慰。
lines.en: Wandering the Coralium wastes of {dimension} alone, even a ghoul's tread might feel like company.

lines.zh: 四周寂静无声，唯有地上遗落的{entity}静静躺在尘埃之中。
lines.en: All is silent around you, save for {entity} resting quietly in the dust.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼下四下无人——这看似安稳的宁静，往往是风暴前最虚伪的假象。
lines.en: Alone beneath a clear noon sky—such apparent calm is often the falsest mask before a storm.

lines.zh: 独自立于寂静的{biome}之上，连微风都仿佛被菌丝吞没了声息。
lines.en: Standing alone upon quiet {biome}, even the breeze seems muffled by the mycelium.

lines.zh: 生命已如风中残烛，而那{hostile}正准备扑上来撕碎你最后的呼吸！
lines.en: Your life flickers at its end while {hostile} prepares to pounce and tear away your last breath!

lines.zh: 伤痕累累却又置身黑夜——黑暗中的猎手们早已嗅到了你流出的鲜血。
lines.en: Grievously wounded in the dead of night—the hunters in the dark have already scented your blood.

lines.zh: 你正带着伤痛面对{hostile}。收起迟疑，要么将它斩杀，要么抽身退去。
lines.en: You face {hostile} while bleeding. Cast off hesitation—strike it down or fall back.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的炽热中引火烧身，可不是什么明智的举动。
lines.en: Catching fire amid the furnace of {dimension} is scarcely a wise maneuver.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}熔岩正吞噬着你的躯壳！快从这片火狱里挣扎出来！
lines.en: The magma of {biome} in {dimension} is devouring your frame! Claw your way out of this inferno!

lines.zh: 你浸没在{biome}冰冷的海水里。莫要游得太深，海底沉睡的东西可不喜欢被打扰。
lines.en: You are submerged in the cold waters of {biome}. Do not dive too deep; what sleeps below dislikes intrusion.

lines.zh: 你在{hostile}的眼皮底下压低身形——但愿这微弱的潜行真能瞒过它的嗅觉。
lines.en: You crouch low before {hostile}—pray such stealth actually deceives its senses.

lines.zh: 你甩开{hostile}疾驰而去，然而奔逃能避开利爪，却避不开宿命。
lines.en: You sprint away from {hostile}; flight may outrun claws, yet it never outruns doom.

lines.zh: 在深夜的星穹之下凌空飞行，你的剪影正清晰地印在月亮与群星的瞳孔里。
lines.en: Soaring beneath the midnight vault, your silhouette stands sharp in the eyes of moon and stars.

lines.zh: 凌空飞越{dimension}的无底虚空吧，一旦失去浮力，下方便是永恒的坠落。
lines.en: Soar above the bottomless void of {dimension}; lose your lift, and below waits an endless fall.

lines.zh: 饥饿在黑夜中愈发啃噬你的力气——莫要等到体能枯竭才想起觅食。
lines.en: Hunger gnaws sharper in the night—do not wait until your strength fails to seek sustenance.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼下，这具躯壳尚且完好无损。好好利用这份难得的安宁吧。
lines.en: Beneath clear daylight, this shell remains hale and whole. Use this brief peace well.

lines.zh: 药剂的魔力在黑夜中流淌，替你披上一层对抗暗影的脆弱屏障。
lines.en: Alchemical potencies course through you in the night, weaving a frail ward against the dark.

lines.zh: 你借着夜色的掩护压低脚步，宛如一名正在潜入禁忌神庙的盗贼。
lines.en: Using the night as cloak, you hush your steps like a thief creeping into a forbidden shrine.

lines.zh: 四周虽无敌人，可你已濒临崩溃——莫让这具空心傀儡倒在无人问津的荒野里。
lines.en: No foe stands near, yet you are on the brink of collapse—do not let this hollow puppet fall in an empty waste.

lines.zh: 烈焰在黑夜中将你变成了一支耀眼的火炬，方圆数里内的怪物此刻都已看见了你。
lines.en: Flames turn you into a blazing beacon in the night; every horror for leagues around has seen you now.

lines.zh: 雨水从天而降，水流在脚下漫延——世界仿佛正在被一场无休止的洪水淹没。
lines.en: Rain pours from above while water rises around you—as if the world were drowning in an endless flood.

lines.zh: 伤势沉重且生命垂危！再不采取措施，黑暗国度便要收回这具傀儡的残骸了。
lines.en: Wounded and failing fast! Act at once, or the Dark Realm will reclaim this simulacrum's wreckage.

lines.zh: 你在黑夜中急速奔跑，衣角掠过无数潜伏在草丛与阴影里的恶意。
lines.en: You sprint headlong through the night, brushing past malice crouching in grass and shade.

lines.zh: 深夜里既腹中空空又两手空空——凡人最狼狈的境地也莫过于此了。
lines.en: Empty-bellied and empty-handed in the dead of night—scarcely could a mortal look more wretched.

lines.zh: 即便在{dimension}这样死寂的圣城里，你依然本能地放轻了脚步，仿佛害怕惊醒沉睡的石像。
lines.en: Even in the dead hush of {dimension}, you soften your tread as though afraid to wake the stone idols.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}这片绝地里重伤濒死，简直是在主动向珊瑚食尸鬼献上自己的血肉。
lines.en: Clinging to a thread of life in {dimension} is practically offering your flesh to the Coralium ghouls.

lines.zh: 挥舞手中的{item}迎向{hostile}吧！用钢铁与鲜血来决定谁才是这片阴影的主人。
lines.en: Raise {item} against {hostile}! Let steel and blood decide who commands these shadows.

lines.zh: 在黑夜的幽暗里，{item}的冷光是你唯一值得信赖的同伴。
lines.en: In the gloom of night, the cold gleam of {item} is the only companion worth trusting.

lines.zh: 拉紧手中的{item}，将死亡从远方精准地送入那{hostile}的胸膛。
lines.en: Draw {item} taut and send death cleanly from afar into {hostile}'s chest.

lines.zh: {hostile}已迫在眉睫，你的双手却空无一物！莫非你想用赤手空拳去撕碎它的利爪？
lines.en: {hostile} closes in while your hands sit empty! Do you mean to meet its claws with bare palms?

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的晦暗天幕下捧着{item}——这本典籍与这座圣城本就同出一源。
lines.en: Holding {item} beneath the dim vault of {dimension}—this tome and this citadel spring from the same dark source.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的绝对虚暗中，手中的{item}几乎是你与理智之间仅存的微弱锚点。
lines.en: In the absolute gloom of {dimension}, {item} in your grasp is nearly the last frail anchor to your wits.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中，{item}的书页仿佛正随着群星的脉动而微微颤动。
lines.en: Under cover of night, the pages of {item} seem to quiver in time with the pulse of the stars.

lines.zh: 深夜翻阅{item}并非良策——黑暗最擅长趁着你专注文字时从背后悄然靠近。
lines.en: Reading {item} in the dead of night is unwise; darkness loves to creep behind those lost in ink.

lines.zh: 腹中饥渴难耐，还不快吞下你手中的{item}，好让这具血肉躯壳勉强维持运转？
lines.en: Hunger gnaws at you—swallow that {item} in your hand before this mortal frame falters.

lines.zh: 用{item}敲开眼前的{block}吧。凡人对地下宝藏的贪欲，永远不会因恐惧而止步。
lines.en: Strike {block} with {item}. Mortal greed for buried treasure never halts for mere dread.

lines.zh: 伤势已然沉重，还不趁早饮下手中那瓶{item}？难道要等到死神降临才肯悔悟？
lines.en: Your wounds run deep—drink that {item} before it is too late, unless you wish to test death's patience.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的荒芜中紧握{item}——唯有深渊锻造的器物，才配得上这片沦陷之地。
lines.en: Gripping {item} in the desolation of {dimension}—only Abyss-forged gear belongs in this fallen realm.

lines.zh: 鲜血已然染红了衣襟，快将手中的{item}穿戴上身，莫再拿脆弱的皮肉去硬抗爪牙。
lines.en: Blood already stains your robes; don that {item} instead of meeting claws with bare hide.

lines.zh: 在{biome}中挥动{item}砍伐{block}——林木倒下的轰鸣，或许会引来林间潜伏的目光。
lines.en: Swinging {item} into {block} across {biome}—the crash of falling timber may draw unseen eyes.

lines.zh: 主手握着{item}，副手亦已备妥——看来你已做好了随时血战一场的觉悟。
lines.en: {item} in your main hand, a reserve in your offhand—it seems you are prepared for a bitter fight.

lines.zh: 四周无人，眼前空无一物，双手亦空空如也——纯粹的空无，恰似创世之前的混沌。
lines.en: No soul near, nothing before your eyes, empty hands—pure emptiness, like the chaos before creation.

lines.zh: 握着{item}面对冰冷的{block}，准备用劳动与汗水去一点点撬开大地的骨骼。
lines.en: Holding {item} before cold {block}, ready to pry apart the bones of the earth bit by bit.

lines.zh: 在黑夜的阴影里匆忙进食{item}，恰如一只躲在洞穴里舔舐残羹的野兽。
lines.en: Hurrying to eat {item} in the dark, like a beast bolting scraps inside its burrow.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着{item}的剑锋滴落，洗不净它曾饮过的鲜血与杀意。
lines.en: Raindrops slide down the edge of {item}, unable to wash away the blood and malice it has drunk.

lines.zh: 两手空空地站在{dimension}之中——连死灵之书也不曾携带，你究竟是来朝圣，还是来送死？
lines.en: Standing empty-handed in {dimension}—without even a Necronomicon, are you here on pilgrimage or to die?

lines.zh: 在{biome}的晦暗土地上，你掌中的{item}正与周围的暗影石产生微弱的共鸣。
lines.en: Upon the dim soil of {biome}, {item} in your palm hums faintly in answer to the surrounding dark.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中握紧{item}，在暗处瞄准那些自以为隐蔽的猎物。
lines.en: Grip {item} in the dark, taking aim at quarry that imagines itself hidden.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的火海之中，翻涌的{block}散发着足以融化一切凡俗造物的酷烈高热。
lines.en: Amid the furnaces of {dimension}, churning {block} radiates heat enough to undo all mortal works.

lines.zh: 看着{dimension}{biome}里无边无际的{block}——深海之下隐藏的秘密，远比陆地更加古老。
lines.en: Behold the boundless {block} of {biome} in {dimension}—the secrets drowned below are far older than dry land.

lines.zh: 烈日下的{biome}满眼皆是滚烫的{block}，干燥的风沙仿佛能把灵魂里的水分也一并抽干。
lines.en: Sun-baked {biome} offers nothing to the eye but {block}, as though dry wind could parch the soul itself.

lines.zh: 竟在{dimension}的{biome}里发现了{block}？看来珊瑚的触须已悄然扎进了这片土地。
lines.en: {block} here in {biome} of {dimension}? Then the tendrils of Coralium have already taken root in this soil.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}之中，每一块{block}都被恐惧瘟疫彻底浸透，成了绝望的基石。
lines.en: Within {dimension}, every slab of {block} is steeped in the Dread Plague—cornerstone of despair.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}看到{block}并不稀奇，深渊的印记早已烙印在这片荒原的骨骼里。
lines.en: Finding {block} in {dimension} is no surprise; the brand of the Abyss is burned into the bones of this waste.

lines.zh: {dimension}的黑暗岩层中嵌着冰冷的{block}——那是被深渊气息凝结而成的沉重金属。
lines.en: Cold {block} gleams within the dark strata of {dimension}—heavy metal condensed from Abyssal breath.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里，随处可见的{block}构成了凡人赖以遮风挡雨的脆弱幻觉。
lines.en: Throughout {biome} in {dimension}, common {block} builds the fragile shelter mortals trust against the dark.

lines.zh: {biome}的绝壁由坚硬的{block}堆叠而成，沉默地俯视着脚下的尘世。
lines.en: The crags of {biome} rise from unyielding {block}, looking down in silence upon the dust below.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的淤泥里挣扎生长的{block}，似乎也沾染了几分沼泽的阴郁与腐气。
lines.en: The {block} struggling out of the mire of {biome} seems tainted with the same sullen rot.

lines.zh: 黑夜里摇曳的{block}虽然温暖，却也在漆黑中替潜行的怪物点亮了你的位置。
lines.en: Dancing {block} feels warm in the night, yet it also beacons your place to whatever stalks the dark.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的硫磺之地，{block}永不熄灭地燃烧着，仿佛连岩石都在承受永恒的刑罚。
lines.en: Across the brimstone of {dimension}, {block} burns without end, as if stone itself suffered eternal torment.

lines.zh: 你压低身形悄然靠近面前的{block}——莫非里面封存着连你自己都心虚的秘密？
lines.en: You crouch low as you edge toward {block}—does it lock away some secret you dare not face upright?

lines.zh: 晴朗白昼的阳光穿透{block}，然而脆弱的晶体永远挡不住来自彼岸的寒意。
lines.en: Clear daylight pierces {block}, yet brittle glass will never bar the chill from beyond the Gate.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}铺满了平庸的{block}，掩盖着地底深处尚未被唤醒的古老恐怖。
lines.en: Plain {block} carpets {biome} in {dimension}, concealing ancient horrors still asleep beneath.

lines.zh: 深夜独自面对空无一物的虚空——这是最容易听见群星以外的低语的时刻。
lines.en: Alone in the dead of night, staring into empty air—no hour carries whispers from beyond the stars more clearly.

lines.zh: 你已深陷滚烫的{block}之中！莫再注视它了，快挣脱这片灼热的泥潭！
lines.en: You are mired in seething {block}! Stop staring at it and claw free of this molten trap!

lines.zh: 你浸泡在冰冷的{block}之中，水波正随着你的动作荡开一圈圈不安的涟漪。
lines.en: You float within cold {block}, ripples spreading uneasily outward with your every move.

lines.zh: {dimension}的岩层中埋藏着{block}。继续掘进吧，凡人——直到你挖穿不该触碰的界限。
lines.en: {block} lies veiled in the rock of {dimension}. Dig on, mortal—until you breach a boundary better left intact.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}那被恐惧扭曲的荒原里，这方{block}竟透出另一股来自奥穆索的古老气息。
lines.en: In the dread-warped wastes of {dimension}, this {block} exhales another, older breath from Omothol.

lines.zh: 你在黑夜中紧盯着那{looked}——当心，暗处的猎物有时也会顺着视线反扑过来。
lines.en: You lock eyes on {looked} in the dark—beware, for quarry in the night may lunge straight back along your gaze.

lines.zh: 阴雨模糊了视线，你却依然隔着雨幕牢牢盯住了那{looked}。
lines.en: Rain blurs the air, yet you hold {looked} squarely in your sight through the downpour.

lines.zh: 重伤之下，你仍死死盯着眼前的{looked}——究竟是绝地反击，还是垂死挣扎？
lines.en: Bleeding and worn, you still fix your stare on {looked}—a desperate stand, or the last twitch of prey?

lines.zh: 两手空空地直视着那{looked}，你倒是有几分不知死活的胆魄。
lines.en: Staring down {looked} with empty hands—you certainly lack neither nerve nor recklessness.

lines.zh: 握紧手中的{item}，去审判你视线所及的那{looked}吧！
lines.en: Grip {item} tight and pass judgment upon {looked} in your sights!

lines.zh: 你压低姿态暗中窥视着{looked}，如同一条准备暴起噬人的毒蛇。
lines.en: Crouched low, you watch {looked} from cover like a serpent coiled to strike.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的火光映照下，你与那{looked}正隔着焦土遥遥对峙。
lines.en: Lit by the glare of {dimension}, you and {looked} face one another across scorched stone.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}之中凝视{looked}——在这座失落圣城里，没有任何注视是毫无代价的。
lines.en: Gazing upon {looked} in {dimension}—within this lost citadel, no stare goes unanswered.

lines.zh: 生死一线之际，你眼中唯有那{looked}！孤注一掷吧，凡人！
lines.en: Hanging by a thread, your eyes see only {looked}! Stake everything on this instant, mortal!

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的虚空里振翼追逐{entity}——两大异界轮廓正在无光之海展开死斗！
lines.en: Soaring through {dimension} in pursuit of {entity}—two alien silhouettes locked in battle over lightless void!

lines.zh: 濒临毁灭的你仍在直面{boss}！若就此倒下，连这具空壳也会被碾作尘埃。
lines.en: On the brink of ruin, you still face {boss}! Fall here, and even this hollow shell will be ground to dust.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中手握死灵之书，而{player}就在一旁——你是打算分享禁忌，还是将他灭口？
lines.en: Clutching the Necronomicon in the dark while {player} stands near—will you share the forbidden, or silence a witness?

lines.zh: {dimension}的雷暴夜里四下无人，仿佛整座世界只剩下你独自承受天穹的怒火。
lines.en: Alone in a thunderstorm across {dimension}, as if the whole world left you to bear the sky's wrath by yourself.

lines.zh: 置身于{biome}的纯粹虚无之中，四周无人，眼前亦空——仿佛世界尚未诞生，又仿佛早已终结。
lines.en: Lost in the pure nothingness of {biome}, no soul near, nothing in sight—as if the world were unborn, or already ended.

lines.zh: 雨水敲打着{dimension}的{biome}，海面泛起无数苍白的泡沫，恰似深渊在黑暗中喘息。
lines.en: Rain lashes {biome} in {dimension}, churning pale foam as though the Abyss itself were breathing in the dark.

lines.zh: 雷暴轰鸣在{dimension}的{biome}上空，闪电照亮了海天之间那令凡人绝望的浩瀚。
lines.en: Thunder rolls over {biome} in {dimension}; lightning lays bare a vastness between sea and sky that crushes mortal pride.

lines.zh: 夜色吞没了{dimension}的{biome}，林木在黑暗中化作扭曲的黑影，低声诉说着未知的恶兆。
lines.en: Night swallows {biome} in {dimension}; timber twists into jagged silhouettes whispering nameless omens.

lines.zh: 冷雨落进{dimension}的{biome}，树叶沙沙作响，掩盖了草丛里正在逼近的脚步。
lines.en: Cold rain falls through {biome} in {dimension}, rustling leaves masking whatever creeps closer in the brush.

lines.zh: 阴雨绵绵不断，将{dimension}的{biome}泡得愈发腐烂，空气里弥漫着死亡的腥甜。
lines.en: Ceaseless rain steeps {biome} in {dimension} deeper into rot, thickening the air with sweet decay.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼铺在{dimension}的{biome}上，看似宁静祥和——多么适合用来掩盖地底的暗流。
lines.en: Clear noon rests over {biome} in {dimension}, calm on the surface—a fine veil for dark currents below.

lines.zh: 黑夜降临在开阔的{dimension}{biome}之上，四野空旷，唯有星辰冷漠地注视着你的身影。
lines.en: Night falls across open {biome} in {dimension}; bare plains stretch wide under the cold stare of the stars.

lines.zh: 严寒的夜晚降临在{dimension}的{biome}，寒风仿佛能将凡人的呼吸直接冻碎在喉咙里。
lines.en: A bitter night settles on {biome} in {dimension}, frost sharp enough to shatter breath in the throat.

lines.zh: 晴空下的{dimension}{biome}一片苍白刺目，冰雪折射着冷光，却没有半点暖意。
lines.en: Beneath a clear sky, {biome} in {dimension} gleams stark white—cold light without a drop of warmth.

lines.zh: 暴雨浇透了{dimension}闷热的{biome}，水汽与瘴气在密林深处久久不散。
lines.en: Downpour drenches steaming {biome} in {dimension}, trapping vapor and miasma beneath the canopy.

lines.zh: 残阳如血，将{dimension}高耸的{biome}染上一层不祥的暗红。
lines.en: A dying sun stains the crags of {biome} in {dimension} with an ominous, blood-dark hue.

lines.zh: 雨势渐大，{dimension}的{biome}水位暗暗上涨，浑浊的波涛拍打着泥泞的岸边。
lines.en: Rain swells {biome} in {dimension}, murky waves lapping higher against the mud.

lines.zh: 黎明微光初现于{dimension}的{biome}，海浪在苍白的晨雾里一遍遍冲刷着沙滩。
lines.en: Pale dawn breaks over {biome} in {dimension}, surf scouring the sand through cold morning mist.

lines.zh: 黑夜里的{dimension}{biome}愈发显得幽暗诡谲，仿佛整片土地随时会沉入黑暗国度。
lines.en: By night, {biome} in {dimension} grows doubly uncanny, as if the whole tract might sink into the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着{dimension}{biome}的黑石滑落，空气中浮动着浓郁的深渊气息。
lines.en: Rain sheets down the dark stone of {biome} in {dimension}, the air thick with Abyssal breath.

lines.zh: 晴朗白昼下的{dimension}{biome}安静得近乎诡异，连一丝暴力的喧嚣都不复存在。
lines.en: Under clear noon, {biome} in {dimension} lies eerily hushed, free of earthly clamor.

lines.zh: 白昼的烈阳烤炙着{dimension}的{biome}，黄沙在热浪中扭曲，令人产生幻觉。
lines.en: Noon heat shimmers across {biome} in {dimension}, warping the dunes into mirages.

lines.zh: 黄昏的余晖落在{dimension}的{biome}之上，赤红的岩壁仿佛在无声地燃烧。
lines.en: Dusk's last embers fall on {biome} in {dimension}, turning its crimson cliffs into silent flame.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里，硫磺与岩浆构成了永恒的炼狱，却依然无法触及真正的外神。
lines.en: In {biome} of {dimension}, sulfur and magma form an endless furnace—yet still fall short of the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 漂浮在{dimension}里的{biome}孤岛沉默不语，周围是吞噬一切的漆黑虚空。
lines.en: The drifting isles of {biome} in {dimension} keep silent watch above all-devouring void.

lines.zh: 你正站在{dimension}的{biome}之中——珊瑚的苍蓝与无尽荒芜交织成深渊的前庭。
lines.en: You stand within {biome} of {dimension}—azure Coralium and endless desolation woven into the Abyss's outer court.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}处处透着血肉畸变的恶寒，仿佛大地本身也在恐惧瘟疫下痛苦呻吟。
lines.en: Every span of {biome} in {dimension} reeks of warped flesh, as though the earth groaned under the Dread Plague.

lines.zh: {dimension}里的{biome}扭曲而焦黑，林木早已沦为恐惧瘟疫滋养的畸形怪物。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} stands blackened and warped, its trees twisted into monuments of the Dread Plague.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}险峻荒凉，山风中夹杂着恐惧守卫与野兽的低沉嘶吼。
lines.en: The {biome} of {dimension} rises bleak and jagged, carrying the low snarls of Dreadguards and beasts.

lines.zh: 此处便是{dimension}的{biome}——我的圣城，群星之外最后一座尚存的黑暗殿堂。
lines.en: This is {biome} of {dimension}—my citadel, the last dark sanctuary standing beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 你已立于{dimension}的{biome}最深处。此处唯有纯粹的黑暗与外神冷漠的注视。
lines.en: You stand at the deepest floor of {biome} in {dimension}—where only pure darkness and cold Outer gazes remain.

lines.zh: 黑夜与虚空在此交融，你独自一人立于{biome}，听不见任何尘世的回响。
lines.en: Night and nothingness merge here; alone in {biome}, you hear not a single earthly echo.

lines.zh: 黑夜笼罩{dimension}，那头腐臭的{hostile}正循着你的气息在暗中逼近。
lines.en: Night blankets {dimension}, and that foul {hostile} creeps closer along your scent.

lines.zh: 夜色之中，那具{entity}拉满弓弦的声响在黑暗里格外刺耳。
lines.en: In the dark of night, the creak of that {entity}'s bowstring cuts razor-sharp.

lines.zh: 黑夜正是多足猎手的舞台——阴影中的{hostile}已盯上了你的咽喉。
lines.en: Night is the hunting hour of many-legged things—{hostile} in the shade has marked your throat.

lines.zh: 即便在{dimension}的白昼阳光下，那只沉默的{hostile}依然带着随时引爆的恶意悄悄靠近。
lines.en: Even in {dimension}'s daylight, that silent {hostile} creeps nearer with explosive malice.

lines.zh: 晴朗白昼下的{dimension}里，{entity}仍在毫无察觉地重复着平凡的交易与劳作。
lines.en: In sunlit {dimension}, {entity} goes on with petty trades and labor, suspecting nothing.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的黑夜里，那个疯癫的{entity}正晃着毒药瓶发出刺耳的怪笑。
lines.en: Through the night of {dimension}, that crazed {entity} cackles over its toxic phials.

lines.zh: 雨水令{dimension}里的{entity}焦躁不安地四处瞬移，每一次现身都带着空间撕裂的轻响。
lines.en: Rain drives {entity} in {dimension} to blink restlessly from spot to spot with faint tears in space.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}潮湿的{biome}里，那团{entity}正如泥沼的衍生物般弹跳不止。
lines.en: Through damp {biome} in {dimension}, that {entity} squelches along like an offshoot of the mire.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}林间，那头野性的{animal}正警惕地打量着你这具异界的躯壳。
lines.en: Among the trees of {biome} in {dimension}, that feral {animal} eyes your alien frame with wariness.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}污浊的{biome}里，一头啃食腐肉的{entity}正在迷雾中低声嘶吼。
lines.en: Within fouled {biome} in {dimension}, a carrion-eating {entity} snarls through the mist.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}火海之间，那头暴虐的{hostile}正带着硫磺气息向你扑来。
lines.en: Amid the flames of {biome} in {dimension}, that brutal {hostile} charges through the brimstone.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}上空，末影巨龙{boss}正傲慢地盘旋——去让它见识深渊的份量吧！
lines.en: Above {biome} in {dimension}, {boss} wheels in haughty flight—teach it the weight of the Abyss!

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}中，{entity}的千万只眼睛正一齐凝视着你——Tekeli-li!
lines.en: Across {biome} in {dimension}, the thousand eyes of {entity} turn upon you at once—Tekeli-li!

lines.zh: 即便在{dimension}的{biome}里，那头被珊瑚寄生的{entity}也早已失去了原本的模样。
lines.en: Even in {biome} of {dimension}, that Coralium-ridden {entity} has long lost its former shape.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}之内，那头被恐惧瘟疫吞噬的{entity}正发出令人作呕的咆哮。
lines.en: Within {biome} of {dimension}, that {entity} consumed by the Dread Plague lets out a sickening roar.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}街道上，那名{entity}仍忠诚地守望着奥穆索最后的余晖。
lines.en: Along the avenues of {biome} in {dimension}, that {entity} still keeps faithful watch over Omothol's last twilight.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}深处，那团{hostile}几乎与永恒的黑暗融为一体。
lines.en: Deep within {biome} of {dimension}, that {hostile} melts nearly seamless into the eternal dark.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的绝对虚暗里，{entity}那倒错而湮灭的气息显得格外刺眼。
lines.en: In the absolute gloom of {dimension}, the inverted, annihilating presence of {entity} stands out starkly.

lines.zh: 深夜之中，你与{player}各自藏在黑暗里。记住，在群星之下，秘密永远是最危险的火种。
lines.en: In the dead of night, you and {player} keep to the dark. Remember: beneath the stars, secrets are the deadliest spark.

lines.zh: {dimension}的黑夜从不怜悯弱者——暗处的{hostile}已将你视作今夜的猎物。
lines.en: The night of {dimension} spares no weakling—{hostile} in the dark has marked you for tonight's quarry.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中整整{count}头怪物围拢过来，{hostile}正领头向你逼近！
lines.en: Full {count} monsters close in through the night, led by {hostile}!

lines.zh: 方圆之内唯有那{count}尊强敌——{boss}正独自等待着与你的死战。
lines.en: Only {count} towering foe stands within reach—{boss} awaits battle alone.

lines.zh: 四下无人的黑夜里，唯有星辰的微光与奥穆索的低语在你耳边轻轻回荡。
lines.en: Alone in the night, only starlight and the whispers of Omothol murmur gently at your ear.

lines.zh: 独自徘徊在{dimension}的破败神庙之间，连遗民的叹息似乎都已远去。
lines.en: Wandering alone among the broken temples of {dimension}, even the sighs of Remnants seem far away.

lines.zh: 晴朗的白昼里四周空无一人，世界安静得仿佛只剩下一块等待画笔的幕布。
lines.en: Alone beneath a clear noon sky, the world lies quiet as an untouched curtain.

lines.zh: 周围别无生灵，唯有那枚孤零零的{entity}躺在尘埃里，等待着被拾起或遗忘。
lines.en: No living thing stirs near—only that lone {entity} resting in the dust, waiting to be claimed or forgotten.

lines.zh: 一枚{entity}正破空袭来，而那该死的{hostile}就在不远处冷笑！
lines.en: A {entity} streaks toward you while that cursed {hostile} lurks nearby!

lines.zh: 在{dimension}之中，那忠实的{entity}静立于门扉之侧，随时听候扎哈尔的差遣。
lines.en: Within {dimension}, that loyal {entity} stands ready beside the Gate, awaiting J'zahar's word.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}里尽是炽热的{block}，翻涌的岩浆随时准备吞没大意的旅人。
lines.en: {biome} in {dimension} teems with seething {block}, ready to swallow any careless traveler.

lines.zh: 晴空之下，{dimension}的{biome}铺满了炽热的{block}，令人目眩神迷。
lines.en: Beneath a clear sky, {biome} in {dimension} stretches out in blinding {block}.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}深处涌动着无边无际的{block}，隐藏着连海图也未曾标注的恐怖。
lines.en: Boundless {block} surges through {biome} in {dimension}, hiding terrors no chart has ever marked.

lines.zh: 雨水不断落入{dimension}的{block}之中，激起无数细碎而冰冷的波纹。
lines.en: Raindrops patter into {block} across {dimension}, raising countless cold, restless ripples.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里竟已出现了{block}——珊瑚的毒素正悄无声息地蔓延。
lines.en: {block} already surfaces in {biome} of {dimension}—Coralium poison spreads without a sound.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}到处都是被恐惧浸透的{block}，散发着铁锈与绝望的气息。
lines.en: {biome} in {dimension} is littered with dread-soaked {block}, exhaling rust and despair.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的黑暗岩壁间嵌着沉重的{block}——那是深渊留给掠夺者的冰冷馈赠。
lines.en: Heavy {block} lies embedded in the dark walls of {dimension}—a cold gift from the Abyss to plunderers.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}深处埋藏着冰冷的{block}，天生便渴望着承接奥穆索的位能。
lines.en: Cold {block} rests within {biome} of {dimension}, born to drink in the Potential Energy of Omothol.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中，{dimension}岩壁里的{block}依然沉默地等待着贪婪的镐尖。
lines.en: In the night, {block} inside the rock of {dimension} waits silently for greedy picks.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}矗立着无数{block}，林木的阴影下潜藏着未知的目光。
lines.en: Countless {block} stand across {biome} in {dimension}, hiding unseen eyes beneath their shade.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}闷热的{biome}里，疯狂生长的{block}纠缠成一道密不透风的绿色迷宫。
lines.en: In steaming {biome} of {dimension}, wild {block} tangles into a suffocating green maze.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}泥沼之中，腐气滋养着随处可见的{block}。
lines.en: In the mire of {biome} in {dimension}, rank rot feeds {block} on every side.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}铺满平庸的{block}，掩盖着地底千万年来未曾见光的骸骨。
lines.en: Plain {block} covers {biome} in {dimension}, hiding bones that have not seen daylight for ages.

lines.zh: {dimension}的{biome}由冷硬的{block}铸成，沉默地承受着风雪与雷霆的捶打。
lines.en: {biome} in {dimension} is hewn of cold {block}, enduring wind and thunder in silence.

lines.zh: {dimension}的焦土上永不熄灭地燃烧着{block}，连空气都在痛苦地扭曲。
lines.en: {block} burns endlessly across the scorched ground of {dimension}, warping the very air.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中，你的目光穿透空无一物的虚空——黑暗里，最危险的往往正是你看不见的东西。
lines.en: In the night, your gaze pierces empty air—in the dark, what you cannot see is often deadliest.

lines.zh: 高悬于半空，四周唯有无形的气流。纵然脱离了大地，你依然逃不出苍穹的注视。
lines.en: Suspended aloft with only empty air around you—leaving the earth does not escape the sky's gaze.

lines.zh: 深夜里你站在{block}之前，清点着这些尘世的积蓄，仿佛它们能替你买回几分安宁。
lines.en: In the dead of night you stand before {block}, counting earthly hoards as if they could buy peace.

lines.zh: 晴朗白昼的阳光透过{block}洒下，却照不暖一颗早已倾听过深渊低语的心智。
lines.en: Clear daylight streams through {block}, yet cannot warm a mind that has heard the Abyss.

lines.zh: 腹中饥火中烧，还不快将手中的{item}送入口中？莫让血肉之躯拖垮了你的意志。
lines.en: Starvation bites—eat that {item} in your hand before frail flesh drags down your will.

lines.zh: 伤势已深，立刻饮下那瓶{item}吧——除非你已准备好提前结束这场荒诞的旅程。
lines.en: Your wounds run deep; drink that {item} now, unless you are ready to end this journey early.

lines.zh: 手中紧握{item}，面前便是{hostile}！让锋刃去替你回答它的咆哮。
lines.en: {item} in hand and {hostile} before you! Let the blade answer its snarl.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中，举起{item}瞄准那在暗处蠢蠢欲动的{hostile}！
lines.en: In the night, raise {item} and loose upon {hostile} stirring in the dark!

lines.zh: 挥动{item}掘开面前的{block}吧——看看大地深处究竟还藏着多少未曾现世的矿藏。
lines.en: Swing {item} into {block}—see what buried wealth still hides within the stone.

lines.zh: 用{item}劈开眼前的{block}，林木倒下之时，阴影便失去了它的遮蔽。
lines.en: Cleave {block} with {item}; when timber falls, shadows lose their cover.

lines.zh: 身上已然负伤，快披上那件{item}吧，莫再让自己的血肉白白暴露在危险之下。
lines.en: Already wounded—put on {item} instead of leaving bare flesh exposed to further harm.

lines.zh: 深夜里握着{item}，究竟是在研读知识，还是在寻找足以安慰自己的虚妄文字？
lines.en: Holding {item} in the dead of night—seeking true lore, or merely words to comfort yourself?

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的圣城里捧着{item}——这本黑皮典籍终于回到了它真正主人的国度。
lines.en: Bearing {item} in the citadel of {dimension}—the dark tome has come home at last to its true master's realm.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的苍白荒原中紧握{item}，这件深渊器物正与周围的珊瑚共鸣不息。
lines.en: Gripping {item} in the pale wastes of {dimension}, this Abyssal relic hums in answer to the Coralium.

lines.zh: 敌人{hostile}就在眼前，你却两手空空！立刻备好兵器，或者准备迎接撕咬吧。
lines.en: {hostile} stands before you and your hands are empty! Ready a weapon or brace for fangs.

lines.zh: 重伤濒死且两手空空——你此刻的处境，简直比奥穆索阶下囚还要凄惨。
lines.en: Critical, bleeding, and empty-handed—scarcely could a captive in Omothol look more helpless.

lines.zh: 黑夜里独自一人、两手空空地站在荒野之中——究竟是无所畏惧，还是已彻底麻木？
lines.en: Alone and empty-handed in the night—utterly fearless, or merely numb?

lines.zh: 主手{item}蓄势待发，副手亦已严阵以待——看来今夜的猎物在劫难逃了。
lines.en: {item} poised and offhand ready—tonight's quarry will not escape easily.

lines.zh: 用{item}去凿碎面前的{block}吧，凡人总是在敲碎石头的过程中寻找着前路。
lines.en: Work {block} with {item}; mortals forever chip their way forward through stone.

lines.zh: 黑夜之中空着手盯着{block}发呆？没有趁手的镐尖，宝藏也只会永远沉睡在岩壁里。
lines.en: Staring at {block} empty-handed in the night? Without a pick, buried ore sleeps on forever.

lines.zh: 你在{dimension}的烈焰中浑身着火！还不快扑灭身上的火苗，难道想化作焦炭？
lines.en: You burn amid the furnaces of {dimension}! Quench the flames before you turn to cinder!

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的{biome}里坠入岩浆、烈火焚身——真是何等狼狈的绝境！
lines.en: Sinking into magma and ablaze in {biome} of {dimension}—what a wretched predicament!

lines.zh: 你漂浮在{dimension}{biome}冰冷的海水中，四面皆是深不可测的蓝。
lines.en: You drift in the cold waves of {biome} in {dimension}, ringed by fathomless blue.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的深夜高空飞行，星辰与月亮正在你头顶冷漠地注视着这具傀儡。
lines.en: Flying high through {dimension}'s night, moon and stars look coldly down upon this simulacrum.

lines.zh: 掠过{dimension}的{biome}孤岛上空——千万抓紧飞行的力量，脚下便是万丈虚无。
lines.en: Skimming above the isles of {biome} in {dimension}—keep your lift, for endless void waits below.

lines.zh: 深夜里压低身形潜行，恰似黑暗国度派出的密探般悄无声息。
lines.en: Creeping low through the dead of night, silent as an emissary of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 面对{hostile}却拔腿狂奔——无论是诱敌深入还是仓皇逃窜，都得拿出些真本事来。
lines.en: Sprinting before {hostile}—whether baiting a trap or fleeing in panic, show some resolve.

lines.zh: 黑夜漫长而饥饿啃噬着胃囊，没有补给的探索者往往最先倒在黎明之前。
lines.en: The night stretches long and hunger gnaws; explorers without provisions fall first before dawn.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}晴朗的白昼下，这具躯壳尚且完好无损——莫要让这份安逸麻痹了你的警觉。
lines.en: Under clear noon in {dimension}, this frame stands whole—do not let ease dull your vigilance.

lines.zh: 深夜之中已然濒死！若再不寻得庇护，黑暗便会毫不留情地吞没你的残影。
lines.en: Dying in the dead of night! Seek shelter at once, or the dark will swallow your last trace without mercy.

lines.zh: 伤痕累累地置身于{dimension}的雷暴之中——连天穹的怒火都在嘲弄你的脆弱。
lines.en: Wounded amid the thunderstorms of {dimension}—even the sky's fury mocks your frailty.

lines.zh: 在黑夜中依靠药剂的微光维系力量——小心莫让药效消散在最危险的时刻。
lines.en: Leaning on potion-light in the dark of night—pray it does not fade at the worst hour.

lines.zh: 身上的火焰在{dimension}的暴雨中嘶嘶熄灭，冰冷的雨水正替你洗去焦灼。
lines.en: Flames hiss out beneath the rain of {dimension}, cold water rinsing away the char.

lines.zh: 天降暴雨，脚下又是积水——天地间的水汽仿佛要将你彻底淹没。
lines.en: Rain pours from above while water rises below—as if the elements meant to drown you whole.

lines.zh: 四周并无外人，你却依然本能地潜行——或许连你自己的影子也让你感到不安？
lines.en: No other soul is near, yet you still crouch in stealth—perhaps even your own shadow makes you uneasy?

lines.zh: 生命垂危之际却仍要面对{hostile}！若无必胜的把握，便立刻退入阴影之中。
lines.en: Facing {hostile} on the edge of death! Without sure victory, slip back into the shadows.

lines.zh: 黑夜里饥肠辘辘却又两手空空——再不寻些食物与武器，你连明晨的太阳都未必见得到。
lines.en: Starving and empty-handed in the night—find food and steel soon, or you may never see tomorrow's sun.

lines.zh: 晴空之下四下无人，你独自凌空翱翔——好一幅傲慢而又孤独的剪影。
lines.en: Alone beneath a clear sky, soaring aloft—what a proud and solitary silhouette.
